BiblicalUsage: Asparna means diligently, quickly, with care, forthwith. In Ezra 5:8 the work on the house of God goes fast on and prospers, and in Ezra 6:8 Darius decrees that expenses be given forthwith, so the elders are not hindered.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's work goes fast when His people build diligently, and the king's haste only hurries what God already ordered.
